headlines.title: Swiss voters crush neutrality initiative that would have ended sanctions against Russia—70% say No - Euromaidan Press
Non! Why the Swiss rejected stricter neutrality
Swiss voters overwhelmingly reject far-right plan to toughen neutrality
How neutral should Switzerland be? Voters deliver decisive verdict
Switzerland rejects stricter interpretation of its neutrality

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Swiss voters rejected a neutrality initiative that would have ended sanctions against Russia, with 70% voting No. [1]
Voters also overwhelmingly rejected a far-right plan to toughen neutrality. [3]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR SWITZERLAND
The rejection of the neutrality initiative means Switzerland will maintain its current sanctions framework, which is linked to 97 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations. [1][E2]

KEY RISKS
Switzerland's net energy import dependency of 52% could pose a risk if sanctions-related disruptions affect energy supply chains. [E3]

OUTLOOK
A Kalshi market related to Switzerland, "Where will Putin and Zelenskyy next meet?: Switzerland", priced Yes at 13% on Sep 28, 2026; it closes Dec 31, 2028. [E4]

WATCH ITEMS
It remains to be seen how the decisive verdict on neutrality will affect Switzerland's future diplomatic and economic relations. [4]
